args: (req, res, next, slug) => { if (!/^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/.test(slug) || slug.length > 60) return res.status(400).json({ message: 'Invalid slug.' }); next(); }

(req, res, next) => { const input = req.method === 'GET' ? req.query : req.body || {}; const fields = [ 'skill', 'topic', 'stack', 'technology', 'language', 'framework', 'difficulty', 'category', 'source', 'block', 'top', 'lookupOnly', 'q', 'query', 'question', 'tags', 'careerStack', 'experienceLevel' ]; for (const field of fields) { if ( input[field] !== undefined && (typeof input[field] !== 'string' || input[field].length > (['q', 'query', 'question', 'tags'].includes(field) ? 500 : 100)) ) { return res.status(400).json({ message: `Invalid ${field}.` }); } } for (const field of ['page', 'limit', 'target']) { if ( input[field] !== undefined && (!['string', 'number'].includes(typeof input[field]) || !Number.isFinite(Number(input[field])) || Number(input[field]) < 1) ) { return res.status(400).json({ message: `Invalid ${field}.` }); } } if (input.difficulty && !['easy', 'medium', 'hard', 'senior'].includes(input.difficulty)) return res.status(400).json({ message: 'Invalid difficulty.' }); next(); }
